messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a Grafana combo/sparkline to correlate KV-cache hit_ratio with per-token latency across LLM-serving pods. Want to catch cache-cold periods that spike per-token 95p. Draft queries below, need feedback on labels/aggregation. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache-latency

Alex R: Query for KV cache hit % (raw idea):
```
100 * sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{job=\"llm-serving\"}[5m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{job=\"llm-serving\"}[5m])) by (instance)
```

Alex R: Query for 95p per-token latency (histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket{job=\"llm-serving\"}[5m])) by (le, instance))
```

Priya S: Nice. Please add model_version and tenant labels to both so we can slice by release/tenant. Also smooth with a 3-sample moving_avg to reduce jitter in sparklines. For hit% consider clamping near-zero requests to avoid division noise.

Mateo G: For the panel type I suggest overlayed area for hit% (right Y axis) and line for latency (left Y axis). And add a heatmap row per-tenant so product teams can scan quickly.

Chen L: Note: our kvcache is sharded per-model + shard_id, so 'instance' might be misleading. Use (model_version, shard_id) or normalize by tokens_served to avoid false correlates when a shard routes less traffic. Example normalizer: tokens_served_total.

Chen L: Also, prefer these adjusted queries:
```
# hit_ratio per model_version, shard_id
100 * sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (model_version, shard_id, tenant) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (model_version, shard_id, tenant)

# 95p latency per model_version, shard_id
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version, shard_id, tenant))
```

Priya S: For alerting: we should trigger when 95p latency rises >25% AND hit_ratio drops >10% over a 10m window for a given (model_version, shard_id, tenant). Keeps false positives down.

Mateo G: Agreed. Here's a composite expression we can use in alertmanager (pseudo PromQL):
```
lat_inc = (increase(latency_95p[10m]) / avg_over_time(latency_95p[10m])) > 0.25
hit_drop = (avg_over_time(hit_ratio[10m]) - avg_over_time(hit_ratio[30m])) < -0.10
lat_inc and hit_drop
```

Alex R: Good pattern. Ops: can we add a panel annotation when autoscaler scales pods or when a model deploy happens? Those events help explain spikes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: model-release matthew/llm-v3 @ 2025-11-07T15:22:11Z (annotation tag: release)

Priya S: Add a toggle to switch grouping between 'by shard' and 'by tenant' in the dashboard. Also provide a download CSV action for top-10 offending shards during an incident.

Alex R: I'll implement these changes, add the two adjusted queries, smoothing, right-axis, and the alert prototype. Will open a PR to infra/grafana-dashboards and ping for review.

Mateo G: If you want, I can prototype the CSV export panel (simple table + builtin CSV).

Alex R: Awesome, thanks. I'll tag you in the PR.

Chen L: One more: add a lightweight sparklines row showing token_request_rate so we can see traffic drops causing noisy ratios.

Alex R: Got it. Plan: update queries, add token_request_rate sparkline, add annotations for releases/autoscaler, implement alert rule, PR by tomorrow. :thumbsup:
